test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kanaka Raju, who kept the tribal folk dance Gussadi alive, was honoured with which of the following civilian awards of India in 2021?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanaka Raju**, a tribal artist from **Telangana**, is renowned for his dedication to preserving the **Gussadi folk dance tradition**.
 
• The **Gussadi dance** is a traditional tribal dance form performed by the **Gond community** during the **Diwali festival**.
 
• Kanaka Raju has played a crucial role in keeping this **tribal art form alive** and popularizing it among modern audiences.
 
• In recognition of his contributions to the promotion and preservation of tribal culture and art, the Government of India conferred upon him the **Padma Shri award in 2021**.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India and is given for distinguished contributions in various fields such as **arts, education, sports, social work, science, and public affairs**.
 
• Kanaka Raju’s recognition brought significant attention to the cultural heritage of the **Gond tribe** and their artistic expression.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**__

 __
 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field, including government service.
 
• It has a higher rank than the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Ratna**__
 __
 
• The **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional service or performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavor.
 
• Instituted in **1954**, it is a rare honor and has been awarded to only a few individuals.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**__
 
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for distinguished service of a high order in various fields.
